description: This file defines a Java interface for data access object (DAO) operations related to OrderProductDownload entities, extending a generic DAO and adding a method to retrieve downloads by order ID.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for OrderProductDownload entities, providing method to retrieve downloads associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getByOrderId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderProductDownload objects associated with the specified order ID.
